```{r tpm_normalization, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: TPM normalization for sfRNA-seq counts
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

library(edgeR)

# ========== 1. Configuration ==========
COUNT_FILE <- "./results/counts/rawcounts.txt"      # Output from count_sfrna.sh
GROUP_FILE <- "./data/rna_group.csv"                  # Sample group information
OUTPUT_DIR <- "./results"                             # Output directory

MIN_COUNT <- 1  # Minimum count threshold for gene filtering

# ========== 2. Initialize Output Directories ==========
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ========== 3. Load Data ==========
counts_raw <- read.delim(COUNT_FILE, 
                         header = TRUE, 
                         sep = "\t", 
                         row.names = 1,
                         check.names = FALSE,
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# featureCounts format: first column is Length
gene_lengths <- counts_raw[, 1]  # Length column
count_matrix <- counts_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE]  # Remove Length column, keep samples

group <- read.csv(GROUP_FILE, header = TRUE)

# ========== 4. Gene Filtering ==========
keep <- filterByExpr(count_matrix, 
                     group = group$colour,
                     min.count = MIN_COUNT)

count_matrix_filtered <- count_matrix[keep, ]
gene_lengths_filtered <- gene_lengths[keep]

# ========== 5. TPM Calculation ==========
calculate_tpm <- function(counts, lengths) {
  # counts: count matrix (genes in rows, samples in columns)
  # lengths: gene lengths in bp
  rpk <- counts / (lengths / 1000)
  scale_factor <- colSums(rpk) / 1e6
  tpm <- t(t(rpk) / scale_factor)
  return(tpm)
}

tpm_matrix <- calculate_tpm(count_matrix_filtered, gene_lengths_filtered)
tpm_df <- as.data.frame(tpm_matrix)

# ========== 6. Save Results ==========
tpm_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "tpm_rna.csv")
counts_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "filtered_counts.csv")

write.csv(tpm_df, tpm_file, row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(count_matrix_filtered, counts_file, row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r coefficient_of_variation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Coefficient of Variation (CV) analysis between groups
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)

# ========== Coefficient of Variation Statistics ==========
# Split data by group based on sample indices
# Note: Assuming first 26 samples are black group, next 97 samples are gray group
blacktpm <- tpm[, 1:26]      # Black group samples
graytpm <- tpm[, 27:123]      # Gray group samples

# Calculate CV for black group
sd_black <- apply(blacktpm, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_black <- apply(blacktpm, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
cv_black <- as.data.frame(sd_black / mean_black * 100)

# Calculate CV for gray group
sd_gray <- apply(graytpm, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_gray <- apply(graytpm, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
cv_gray <- as.data.frame(sd_gray / mean_gray * 100)

# Combine and reshape data
cv_df <- cbind(cv_black, cv_gray)
names(cv_df) <- c('black', 'gray')

df_long <- cv_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "colour",
    values_to = "Expression"
  )
df_long$Expression <- log(df_long$Expression)

# Generate violin plot with boxplot overlay
cv_vln <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = colour, y = Expression, fill = colour)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.6, width = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), linewidth = 0.4) +
  stat_compare_means(method = 't.test', label.x = 1.25, 
                    label.y = max(df_long$Expression, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,
                    size = 4.5, bracket.size = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3f60aa", "#e6553a"), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3f60aa", "#e6553a"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Coefficient of Variation") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray95", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

print(cv_vln)

# Save figure
ggsave(file.path("results/figures", "cv_violin.png"), 
       plot = cv_vln, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r differential_expression_analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Differential expression analysis using edgeR
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

## ===================== Load Libraries =====================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(edgeR)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})

## ===================== Data Preparation =====================
# Load group information
group <- read.csv("data/rna_group.csv", header = TRUE)
group$colour <- factor(group$colour)

# Load filtered counts
cnts <- read.csv("results/tables/filtered_counts.csv", 
                 header = TRUE, 
                 row.names = 1)
# Extract count matrix (remove gene length column)
cnts_matrix <- cnts[, -1, drop = FALSE]

# Create DGE object
dge <- DGEList(counts = cnts_matrix, group = group$colour)

## ===================== Filter Low-Expressed Genes =====================
keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = group$colour, min.count = 1)
dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

## ===================== Normalization and Design Matrix =====================
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
design <- model.matrix(~ group$colour)

## ===================== Differential Expression Analysis =====================
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design)
fit <- glmFit(dge, design)
lrt <- glmLRT(fit, coef = 2)   # coef=2 indicates second level vs first level

deg_result <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
deg_result$gene <- rownames(deg_result)

## ===================== Threshold Classification =====================
logFC_cutoff <- 2
FDR_cutoff   <- 0.05

group_levels <- levels(group$colour)
contrast <- paste(group_levels[2], "vs", group_levels[1])

deg_result <- deg_result %>%
  mutate(threshold = case_when(
    logFC >= logFC_cutoff & FDR < FDR_cutoff ~ paste0(group_levels[2], "_high"),
    logFC <= -logFC_cutoff & FDR < FDR_cutoff ~ paste0(group_levels[1], "_high"),
    TRUE ~ "Not Sig"
  ))

num_group1_up <- sum(deg_result$threshold == paste0(group_levels[1], "_high"))
num_group2_up <- sum(deg_result$threshold == paste0(group_levels[2], "_high"))

## ===================== Volcano Plot =====================
# Define color mapping
color_map <- setNames(
  c("#2166AC", "#B2182B", "gray80"),
  c(paste0(group_levels[1], "_high"),
    paste0(group_levels[2], "_high"),
    "Not Sig")
)

p <- ggplot(deg_result, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR), color = threshold)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFC_cutoff, logFC_cutoff),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(FDR_cutoff),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Volcano Plot of DEGs (edgeR, ", contrast, ")\n",
                   group_levels[1], "_high: ", num_group1_up,
                   ", ", group_levels[2], "_high: ", num_group2_up),
    x = paste0("log2 Fold Change (", contrast, ")"),
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = "DEG Direction"
  )

print(p)
ggsave(file.path("results/figures", "deg_volcano.png"), p)

# Save significant DEG results
dge_sig_result <- subset(deg_result, 
                         deg_result$threshold == paste0(group_levels[1], "_high") | 
                         deg_result$threshold == paste0(group_levels[2], "_high"))

write.csv(dge_sig_result, 
          file.path("results/tables", "deg_sig.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r principal_component_analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: PCA analysis for sfRNA-seq samples
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

library(ggplot2)

# ========== Data Preparation ==========
tpm <- read.csv("results/tables/tpm_rna.csv", row.names = 1)
group <- read.csv("data/rna_group.csv", header = TRUE)

# PCA analysis
data <- log10(tpm[apply(tpm, 1, var) != 0, ] + 1)
pca <- prcomp(t(data), scale. = TRUE)
pca.data <- data.frame(pca$x)
pca.variance <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

# ========== PCA Plot Function ==========
plot_pca <- function(i, j) {
  pcaplot <- ggplot(pca.data, aes(x = pca.data[, i], y = pca.data[, j], color = group$colour)) +
    geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.4) +
    stat_ellipse(linetype = "longdash", linewidth = 0.6, level = 0.95, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Hair Colour", values = c("#3f60aa", "#e6553a")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
          aspect.ratio = 1) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC", i, " (", signif(pca.variance[i] * 100, 3), "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC", j, " (", signif(pca.variance[j] * 100, 3), "%)"))
  
  ggsave(file.path("results/figures", paste0("pca_pc", i, "_pc", j, ".png")), 
         pcaplot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  print(pcaplot)
}

# ========== Generate PCA Plots ==========
plot_pca(1, 2)  # PC1 vs PC2
plot_pca(3, 7)  # PC3 vs PC7
```

```{r pca_density_distribution, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Density distribution of principal components
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

library(patchwork)

# ========== Density Distribution of Principal Components ==========
# Ensure sample order matches pca.data
group <- group[match(rownames(pca.data), group$sample), ]

# Combine data
pca_plotdata <- cbind(pca.data[, 1:10], colour = group$colour)

# ========== Generate 10 Density Plots ==========
plot_list <- list()

for (i in 1:10) {
  pc_name <- paste0("PC", i)
  
  p <- ggplot(pca_plotdata, aes(x = .data[[pc_name]], fill = colour)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("black" = "#3f60aa", "gray" = "#cc340c")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 11),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    labs(title = pc_name, x = "", y = "Density")
  
  # Add legend to the last plot
  if (i == 10) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                   legend.title = element_blank(),
                   legend.text = element_text(size = 9))
  }
  
  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}

# ========== Arrange in 2 rows x 5 columns ==========

  plot_annotation(
    title = "Density distribution of principal components 1-10",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))
  )

# ========== Save ==========
ggsave(file.path("results/figures", "pca_density.png"), 
       combined_plot, width = 15, height = 8, dpi = 300)
print(combined_plot)
```

```{r permanova_analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: PERMANOVA analysis on weighted principal components
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

library(vegan)
set.seed(123)

# ========== Weighted Principal Components PERMANOVA ==========
# Convert age to numeric
group$age <- as.numeric(as.character(group$age))

# Weight PCs by their variance contribution
pca_weighted <- sweep(pca.data, 2, sqrt(pca.variance), "*")

# Perform PERMANOVA
permanova_weighted <- adonis2(pca_weighted ~ colour + age + gender + donor,
                             data = group,
                             permutations = 999,
                             method = "euclidean",
                             by = "terms")

# Save PERMANOVA results
write.csv(as.data.frame(permanova_weighted), 
          file.path("results/tables", "permanova_results.csv"), 
          row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r variance_test, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: PCA violin plots with variance homogeneity test
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

# ========== PCA Violin Plot with Variance Test ==========
plot_pca_violin_with_var_test <- function(pca.data, group, top_n_pcs = 10) {
  library(ggplot2)
  library(reshape2)
  library(dplyr)

  # Step 1: reshape PCA matrix
  pca_long <- data.frame(sample = rownames(pca.data), pca.data[, 1:top_n_pcs])
  pcdensity <- reshape2::melt(pca_long, id.vars = "sample", variable.name = "PC", value.name = "value")

  # Step 2: add group info
  pcdensity$colour <- group$colour[match(pcdensity$sample, group$sample)]
  pcdensity$colour <- as.factor(pcdensity$colour)

  # Step 3: statistics + direction
  stat_result <- pcdensity %>%
    group_by(PC) %>%
    summarise(
      t_p = tryCatch(t.test(value ~ colour)$p.value, error = function(e) NA),
      var_p = tryCatch(var.test(value ~ colour)$p.value, error = function(e) NA),
      mean_gray = mean(value[colour == "gray"], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_black = mean(value[colour == "black"], na.rm = TRUE),
      y = max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - (max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.05
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_star = case_when(
        is.na(t_p) ~ "NA",
        t_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        t_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
        t_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      var_star = case_when(
        is.na(var_p) ~ "NA",
        var_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        var_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
        var_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      direction_label = case_when(
        abs(mean_gray - mean_black) < 1e-6 ~ "~",
        mean_gray > mean_black ~ "gray ↑",
        mean_gray < mean_black ~ "black ↑",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      label = paste0(var_star)
    )

  stat_result$PC <- factor(stat_result$PC, levels = paste0("PC", 1:top_n_pcs))

  # Step 4: generate plot
  violin_plot <- ggplot(pcdensity, aes(x = colour, y = value, fill = colour)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~PC, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
    geom_text(data = stat_result,
              aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.8, lineheight = 1.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray" = "#cc340c", "black" = "#3f60aa")) +
    labs(x = "", y = "PC Score", fill = "Group") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
    )

  print(violin_plot)
  ggsave(file.path("results/figures", "pca_violin_var_test.png"), 
         plot = violin_plot, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  return(stat_result)
}

var_result_table <- plot_pca_violin_with_var_test(pca.data, group, top_n_pcs = 10)

# Save statistical results
write.csv(var_result_table, 
          file.path("results/tables", "pca_var_test_results.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r pc_coordinates_boxplot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Boxplot of principal component coordinates with t-test significance
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

library(ggpubr)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)

# ===== 1. Reshape to long format =====
pcdensity <- reshape2::melt(pca.data[, 1:10])  # variable = PC name, value = score
pcdensity$colour <- group$colour

# ===== 2. T-test for each PC =====
ttest_result <- pcdensity %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    p = tryCatch({
      g1 <- value[colour == levels(as.factor(colour))[1]]
      g2 <- value[colour == levels(as.factor(colour))[2]]
      t.test(g1, g2)$p.value
    }, error = function(e) NA)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p = round(p, 4),
    signif = case_when(
      is.na(p) ~ "NA",
      p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ " "
    ),
    y.position = tapply(
      pcdensity$value,
      pcdensity$variable,
      function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.15 * diff(range(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    ) %>% unname(),
    group1 = NA,
    group2 = NA
  )

# ===== 3. Generate boxplot with significance =====
pcs_boxplot <- ggboxplot(
  pcdensity, x = 'variable', y = 'value', color = 'colour',
  ylab = "Coordinates", xlab = "", width = 0.6, add = "none"
) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3f60aa", "#cc340c")) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    ttest_result[, c("variable", "y.position", "signif", "group1", "group2")],
    x = "variable", label = "signif", y.position = "y.position",
    tip.length = 0.01, size = 4
  )

ggsave(file.path("results/figures", "pcs_boxplot.png"), 
       plot = pcs_boxplot, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
print(pcs_boxplot)

# Save t-test results
write.csv(ttest_result, 
          file.path("results/tables", "pca_ttest_results.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r zscore_loading_extraction, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Extract significant loading genes for each PC using Z-score threshold
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

# -------- Parameter Settings --------
dir.create(file.path("results/tables", "loading_genes"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rotation <- pca$rotation
target_p <- 0.05  # Two-tailed significance level
z_threshold <- qnorm(1 - target_p / 2)  # Convert to Z-score threshold

# -------- Extract significant loading genes for each PC --------
all_topload <- list()

for (i in 1:10) {
  pc_loading <- rotation[, i]  # Loading vector for current PC
  
  # Standardize while preserving row names
  pc_z <- scale(pc_loading)[, 1]
  names(pc_z) <- rownames(rotation)

  # Positive: Z > threshold
  pos_idx <- which(pc_z > z_threshold)
  positive <- data.frame(
    gene = rownames(rotation)[pos_idx],
    zscore = pc_z[pos_idx],
    loading = pc_loading[pos_idx],
    group = "positive",
    pc = i
  )

  # Negative: Z < -threshold
  neg_idx <- which(pc_z < -z_threshold)
  negative <- data.frame(
    gene = rownames(rotation)[neg_idx],
    zscore = pc_z[neg_idx],
    loading = pc_loading[neg_idx],
    group = "negative",
    pc = i
  )

  # Combine
  topload <- rbind(positive, negative)

  # Save
  output_file <- file.path("results/tables", "loading_genes", paste0("PC", i, "_top_genes.csv"))
  if (nrow(topload) > 0) {
    write.csv(topload, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
  }

  all_topload[[i]] <- topload
}

# -------- Combine all PC results --------
final_table <- do.call(rbind, all_topload)
write.csv(final_table, file.path("results/tables", "loading_genes", "all_PCs_top_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# -------- Print summary statistics --------
cat("\nSignificant gene counts (Z threshold =", round(z_threshold, 4), ")\n")
for (i in 1:10) {
  df <- all_topload[[i]]
  pos_count <- sum(df$group == "positive")
  neg_count <- sum(df$group == "negative")
  cat("PC", i, "→ Positive:", pos_count, "Negative:", neg_count, "\n")
}
```

```{r umap_louvain_clustering, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: UMAP dimensionality reduction and Louvain clustering on gray hair samples
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

# ===== UMAP + Louvain Clustering (Gray Hair Samples Only) =====
library(uwot)
library(igraph)
library(FNN)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ====== Parameter Settings ======
selected_pcs <- c(1, 3, 7)  # PCs associated with gray hair
point_size <- 3
set.seed(42)

# ====== Split TPM Data ======
blacktpm <- tpm[, 1:26]
graytpm  <- tpm[, 27:123]
logtpm   <- log(tpm + 1)

# ====== 1. Gene Selection Based on PC Positive Loadings ======
ordered_genes <- c()
gene_group_label <- c()

for (i in selected_pcs) {
  selected_genes <- all_topload[[i]]$gene[all_topload[[i]]$group == "positive"]
  ordered_genes <- c(ordered_genes, selected_genes)
  gene_group_label <- c(gene_group_label, rep(paste0("PC", i, "_positive"), length(selected_genes)))
}

# Remove duplicates
df_gene <- data.frame(Gene = ordered_genes, Group = gene_group_label) %>% 
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
ordered_genes <- df_gene$Gene

# ====== 2. Build Expression Matrix (Gray Samples Only) ======
expr_gray <- t(logtpm[ordered_genes, colnames(graytpm)])  # rows = samples, columns = genes

# ====== 3. UMAP Dimensionality Reduction ======
umap_coords <- umap(expr_gray, 
                    n_neighbors = 10, 
                    min_dist = 0.3, 
                    metric = "cosine", 
                    scale = TRUE)
rownames(umap_coords) <- rownames(expr_gray)

# ====== 4. Louvain Clustering ======
nn <- get.knn(umap_coords, k = min(15, nrow(umap_coords) - 1))
edges <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(nn$nn.index), function(i) {
  cbind(from = i, to = nn$nn.index[i, ])
}))
g <- graph_from_edgelist(edges, directed = FALSE) %>% simplify()
cl <- cluster_louvain(g)
clusters <- cl$membership
names(clusters) <- rownames(umap_coords)

# ====== 5. Construct Data Frame ======
umap_df <- data.frame(
  Sample  = rownames(umap_coords),
  UMAP1   = umap_coords[, 1],
  UMAP2   = umap_coords[, 2],
  Cluster = paste0("Cluster_", clusters)
)

# ====== 6. Rename Clusters: Cluster_1 -> Gray1, Cluster_2 -> Gray2, ... ======
lv <- levels(factor(umap_df$Cluster))
# Sort by numeric order
lv_sorted <- lv[order(as.integer(sub(".*_(\\d+)$", "\\1", lv)))]

# Create mapping
map_gray <- setNames(paste0("Gray", seq_along(lv_sorted)), lv_sorted)

# Apply renaming
umap_df$Cluster <- map_gray[umap_df$Cluster]
umap_df$Cluster <- factor(umap_df$Cluster, levels = paste0("Gray", seq_along(lv_sorted)))

# ====== 7. Set Colors ======
gray_cols <- c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3", "#FF7F00", "#A65628")
cluster_palette <- setNames(gray_cols[1:length(lv_sorted)], paste0("Gray", seq_along(lv_sorted)))

# ====== 8. Generate Plot ======
p <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_palette) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2", color = "Cluster")
print(p)

# ====== 9. Save Results ======
ggsave(file.path("results/figures", "umap_gray_only_PC1_3_7.png"), 
       plot = p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# Save clustering results
write.csv(umap_df, 
          file.path("results/tables", "umap_clustering_results.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r cluster_marker_genes, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Differential expression analysis for gray hair subclusters using edgeR
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

# ===== Gray Subcluster Marker Gene Analysis (edgeR) =====
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(edgeR)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})

# Required objects:
#   cnts            : raw integer count matrix (gene x sample), first column may be gene length
#   annotation_col  : data.frame with sample names as rownames, containing column "Cluster"

# -------- 0. Check and prepare input --------
stopifnot(is.matrix(cnts) || is.data.frame(cnts))
cnts <- as.matrix(cnts)
if (!is.integer(cnts)) storage.mode(cnts) <- "integer"

# Remove gene length column if present
if (colnames(cnts)[1] == "Length") {
  cnts_matrix <- cnts[, -1, drop = FALSE]
} else {
  cnts_matrix <- cnts
}

stopifnot("Cluster" %in% colnames(annotation_col))
stopifnot(all(colnames(cnts_matrix) %in% rownames(annotation_col)))

# Align groups (column names = samples)
group <- factor(annotation_col[colnames(cnts_matrix), "Cluster"],
                levels = sort(unique(annotation_col$Cluster)))

# -------- 1. edgeR Basic Processing --------
dge <- DGEList(counts = cnts_matrix, group = group)

# Filter low-expressed genes
keep <- filterByExpr(dge, design = model.matrix(~0 + group))
dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# TMM normalization
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

# Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

# Estimate dispersion
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design)

# Single fit, multiple contrasts
fit <- glmFit(dge, design)

# -------- Helper function: collect contrast results with cluster label --------
collect_contrast <- function(fit, cont_col, cont_matrix, cluster_label) {
  lrt <- glmLRT(fit, contrast = cont_matrix[, cont_col])
  tt  <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
  tt$gene <- rownames(tt)
  tt$cluster <- cluster_label
  rownames(tt) <- NULL
  tt
}

# -------- Helper function: add regulation status and significance --------
add_regulation <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      regulation = case_when(
        FDR < 0.05 & logFC >=  2 ~ "Up",
        FDR < 0.05 & logFC <= -2 ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NotSig"
      ),
      signif = regulation != "NotSig"
    )
}

# ===================== Each Gray vs Black =====================
targets <- levels(group)
if (!("Black" %in% targets)) stop("Black group not found in annotation_col$Cluster.")

gray_levels <- setdiff(targets, "Black")
if (length(gray_levels) == 0) stop("No other groups to compare with Black.")

contr_gray_vs_black <- setNames(
  paste0(gray_levels, " - Black"),
  gray_levels
)
cont_mat_A <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contr_gray_vs_black, levels = design)

res_list_A <- lapply(colnames(cont_mat_A), function(co) {
  cluster_label <- sub(" - Black$", "", co)
  collect_contrast(fit, co, cont_mat_A, cluster_label = cluster_label)
})
res_df_A <- do.call(rbind, res_list_A) %>% add_regulation()
sig_df_A <- res_df_A %>% filter(signif)
sig_df_A <- as.data.frame(sig_df_A)

# Save results
write.csv(sig_df_A, 
          file.path("results/tables", "DEGs_gray_subtypes_vs_black.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Bar plot: Gray vs Black
# Keep only Gray clusters
gray_clusters <- unique(sig_df_A$cluster[!grepl("Black", sig_df_A$cluster)])
sig_df_A_gray <- sig_df_A[sig_df_A$cluster %in% gray_clusters, ]

# Extract Up and Down genes
up_down <- sig_df_A_gray[sig_df_A_gray$regulation %in% c("Up", "Down"), ]

if (nrow(up_down) > 0) {
  # Manual counting
  counts_list <- table(up_down$cluster, up_down$regulation)
  counts_A <- as.data.frame(counts_list)
  colnames(counts_A) <- c("cluster", "regulation", "n")
  
  # Downregulated as negative
  counts_A$n <- ifelse(counts_A$regulation == "Down", -counts_A$n, counts_A$n)
  
  pA <- ggplot(counts_A, aes(x = cluster, y = n, fill = regulation)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up" = "#D73027", "Down" = "#4575B4")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
    labs(title = "Gray subtypes vs Black: Number of DEGs",
         x = "Cluster", y = "Number of DEGs") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)
  
  ggsave(file.path("results/figures", "barplot_DEGs_gray_vs_black.png"), 
         pA, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  print(pA)
}

# ===================== One-vs-Rest =====================
ovr_contrasts <- vapply(targets, function(g) {
  others <- setdiff(targets, g)
  paste0(g, " - (", paste(others, collapse = " + "), ")/", length(others))
}, FUN.VALUE = character(1))

cont_mat_B <- makeContrasts(contrasts = ovr_contrasts, levels = design)
stopifnot(length(colnames(cont_mat_B)) == length(targets))

res_list_B <- lapply(seq_along(targets), function(i) {
  co <- colnames(cont_mat_B)[i]
  g  <- targets[i]
  collect_contrast(fit, co, cont_mat_B, cluster_label = g)
})
res_df_B <- do.call(rbind, res_list_B) %>% add_regulation()
sig_df_B <- res_df_B %>% filter(signif)
sig_df_B <- as.data.frame(sig_df_B)

# Save results
write.csv(sig_df_B, 
          file.path("results/tables", "DEGs_one_vs_rest.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Bar plot: One-vs-Rest
up_down_B <- sig_df_B[sig_df_B$regulation %in% c("Up", "Down"), ]

if (nrow(up_down_B) > 0) {
  counts_list_B <- table(up_down_B$cluster, up_down_B$regulation)
  counts_B <- as.data.frame(counts_list_B)
  colnames(counts_B) <- c("cluster", "regulation", "n")
  
  counts_B$n <- ifelse(counts_B$regulation == "Down", -counts_B$n, counts_B$n)
  
  pB <- ggplot(counts_B, aes(x = cluster, y = n, fill = regulation)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up" = "#D73027", "Down" = "#4575B4")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
    labs(title = "One-vs-Rest: DEGs per cluster",
         x = "Cluster", y = "Number of DEGs") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)
  
  ggsave(file.path("results/figures", "barplot_DEGs_one_vs_rest.png"), 
         pB, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  print(pB)
}

# ===================== Extract Up/Down Gene Lists =====================
get_gene_table <- function(sig_df, direction = c("Up", "Down"), clusters = NULL) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  if (is.null(clusters)) clusters <- sort(unique(sig_df$cluster))
  
  if (direction == "Up") {
    df <- sig_df[sig_df$regulation == "Up", ]
    df <- df[order(df$FDR, -df$logFC), ]
  } else {
    df <- sig_df[sig_df$regulation == "Down", ]
    df <- df[order(df$FDR, df$logFC), ]
  }
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cols <- setNames(rep(list(character(0)), length(clusters)), clusters)
    return(as.data.frame(cols, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE))
  }
  
  # Gene lists per cluster
  gene_lists <- list()
  for (cl in clusters) {
    genes <- unique(df$gene[df$cluster == cl])
    gene_lists[[cl]] <- genes
  }
  
  # Pad to equal length
  max_len <- max(sapply(gene_lists, length))
  result <- data.frame(matrix("", nrow = max_len, ncol = length(clusters)))
  colnames(result) <- clusters
  
  for (cl in clusters) {
    genes <- gene_lists[[cl]]
    if (length(genes) > 0) {
      result[1:length(genes), cl] <- genes
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Gray vs Black up/down gene lists
if (nrow(sig_df_A) > 0) {
  clusters_A <- sort(unique(sig_df_A$cluster))
  up_genes_A_df   <- get_gene_table(sig_df_A, direction = "Up",   clusters = clusters_A)
  down_genes_A_df <- get_gene_table(sig_df_A, direction = "Down", clusters = clusters_A)
  
  write.csv(up_genes_A_df,   
            file.path("results/tables", "gene_lists_gray_vs_black_up.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(down_genes_A_df, 
            file.path("results/tables", "gene_lists_gray_vs_black_down.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
}

# One-vs-Rest up/down gene lists
if (nrow(sig_df_B) > 0) {
  clusters_B <- sort(unique(sig_df_B$cluster))
  up_genes_B_df   <- get_gene_table(sig_df_B, direction = "Up",   clusters = clusters_B)
  down_genes_B_df <- get_gene_table(sig_df_B, direction = "Down", clusters = clusters_B)
  
  write.csv(up_genes_B_df,   
            file.path("results/tables", "gene_lists_one_vs_rest_up.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(down_genes_B_df, 
            file.path("results/tables", "gene_lists_one_vs_rest_down.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r cluster_enrichment_dotplot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Enrichment analysis dot plot for gray hair subclusters
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

# ===== Enrichment Dot Plot for Gray Subclusters =====
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ========= Load Data =========
df_wide <- read.csv("data/gray_cluster_batch_enrichment.csv", 
                     check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ========= Reshape to Long Format =========
df_long <- df_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("_LogP_"),
    names_to = "Cluster",
    names_prefix = "_LogP_",
    values_to = "LogP"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = c("Gray1", "Gray2", "Gray3", "Gray4")),
    LogP = as.numeric(LogP),
    score = -LogP,
    Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(unique(Description)))
  ) %>%
  filter(score > 0)

# ========= Top 10 per Cluster =========
top_n <- 10
df_top <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(score), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(unique(Description))))

# ========= Color Scheme =========
cluster_colors <- c(
  "Gray1" = "#E41A1C",
  "Gray2" = "#377EB8",
  "Gray3" = "#4DAF4A",
  "Gray4" = "#984EA3"
)

# ========= Dot Plot =========
p <- ggplot(df_top, aes(x = Cluster, y = Description)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = score, fill = Cluster), 
             shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = expression(bold(-log[10](p))),
    range = c(10, 20),
    breaks = c(2, 5, 10, 20, 50)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Gray1", "Gray2", "Gray3", "Gray4")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold", 
                               angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  ) +
  labs(title = "", x = NULL, y = NULL)

print(p)

# ========= Save =========
ggsave(file.path("results/figures", "enrichment_bubble_gray_clusters.png"), 
       p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r ssgsea_analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: ssGSEA analysis for pathway enrichment in gray hair subclusters
# Workflow: Part 01 - sfRNA-seq downstream analysis

# ===== ssGSEA Analysis - Heatmap for Significant Pathway Selection =====
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)

# ===========================================
# Load Gene Set CSV File
# ===========================================

gene_sets_df <- read.csv("data/pathway_gene_sets.csv", 
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Convert to list format for ssGSEA
gene_sets <- list()
pathway_names_map <- list()

for (pathway_code in unique(gene_sets_df$Pathway_Code)) {
  # Extract all genes for this pathway
  pathway_genes <- gene_sets_df$Gene[gene_sets_df$Pathway_Code == pathway_code]
  gene_sets[[pathway_code]] <- paste(pathway_genes, collapse = ",")
  
  # Save full pathway name
  pathway_full <- unique(gene_sets_df$Pathway_Name[gene_sets_df$Pathway_Code == pathway_code])
  pathway_names_map[[pathway_code]] <- pathway_full[1]
}

# ===========================================
# Data Preparation
# ===========================================

# Use TPM data
expr_matrix <- as.matrix(log(tpm + 1))  # log(TPM+1) transformation

# Sample grouping information
samples <- rownames(annotation_col)
clusters <- annotation_col$Cluster

metadata_df <- data.frame(
  sample_id = samples,
  condition = factor(clusters, levels = c("Black", "Gray1", "Gray2", "Gray3", "Gray4"))
)

# ===========================================
# ssGSEA Function
# ===========================================

ssgsea_score <- function(expr_matrix, gene_list) {
  available_genes <- intersect(gene_list, rownames(expr_matrix))
  if (length(available_genes) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  scores <- sapply(colnames(expr_matrix), function(sample) {
    expr_values <- expr_matrix[, sample]
    expr_rank <- rank(-expr_values, ties.method = "average")
    weights <- 1/expr_rank
    in_set <- rownames(expr_matrix) %in% available_genes
    weighted_sum <- sum(expr_values[in_set] * weights[in_set])
    total_weight <- sum(weights[in_set])
    if (total_weight > 0) weighted_sum / total_weight else 0
  })
  return(scores)
}

# ===========================================
# Color Definition (consistent with UMAP)
# ===========================================

cluster_colors <- c(
  "Black" = "#000000",
  "Gray1" = "#E41A1C",
  "Gray2" = "#377EB8", 
  "Gray3" = "#4DAF4A",
  "Gray4" = "#984EA3"
)

# ===========================================
# Statistical Test Function (retain t-test p-values only)
# ===========================================

perform_statistical_tests <- function(scores_df) {
  conditions <- levels(scores_df$condition)
  n_conditions <- length(conditions)
  
  if (n_conditions < 2) return(data.frame())
  
  stats_results <- data.frame()
  
  for (i in 1:(n_conditions-1)) {
    for (j in (i+1):n_conditions) {
      group1 <- conditions[i]
      group2 <- conditions[j]
      
      data1 <- scores_df$Pathway_Score[scores_df$condition == group1]
      data2 <- scores_df$Pathway_Score[scores_df$condition == group2]
      
      t_test <- tryCatch({
        t.test(data1, data2)
      }, error = function(e) {
        list(p.value = NA)
      })
      
      stats_row <- data.frame(
        Group1 = group1,
        Group2 = group2,
        Comparison = paste(group1, "vs", group2),
        T_p_value = ifelse(!is.null(t_test$p.value), t_test$p.value, NA)
      )
      
      stats_results <- rbind(stats_results, stats_row)
    }
  }
  
  return(stats_results)
}

# ===========================================
# Batch Analysis of All Pathways (save results for heatmap only)
# ===========================================

all_results <- list()
all_statistics <- data.frame()

for (selected_set in names(gene_sets)) {
  gene_input <- gene_sets[[selected_set]]  
  pathway_name <- ifelse(selected_set %in% names(pathway_names_map),
                         pathway_names_map[[selected_set]], selected_set)
  
  genes <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(gene_input, ",")))
  available_genes <- genes[genes %in% rownames(expr_matrix)]
  
  if (length(available_genes) < 3) next
  
  geneset_scores <- ssgsea_score(expr_matrix, available_genes)
  if (is.null(geneset_scores)) next
  
  result_df <- data.frame(
    sample = names(geneset_scores),
    Pathway_Score = geneset_scores,
    condition = metadata_df$condition[match(names(geneset_scores), metadata_df$sample_id)]
  )
  
  result_df$condition <- factor(result_df$condition, levels = c("Black", "Gray1", "Gray2", "Gray3", "Gray4"))
  
  group_means <- result_df %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(mean_score = mean(Pathway_Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')
  
  stats_results <- perform_statistical_tests(result_df)
  
  if (nrow(stats_results) > 0) {
    stats_results$Pathway <- selected_set
    stats_results$Pathway_Name <- pathway_name
    stats_results$Available_Genes <- length(available_genes)
    stats_results$Total_Genes <- length(genes)
    stats_results$Gene_Coverage <- round(length(available_genes) / length(genes) * 100, 1)
    stats_results$Min_P_Value <- min(stats_results$T_p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    all_statistics <- rbind(all_statistics, stats_results)
  }
  
  all_results[[selected_set]] <- list(
    scores = result_df,
    group_means = group_means,
    available_genes = available_genes,
    statistics = stats_results
  )
}

# ===========================================
# Filter Significant Pathways (p < 0.05)
# ===========================================

significant_pathways <- c()

for (pathway_name in names(all_results)) {
  stats_df <- all_results[[pathway_name]]$statistics
  
  if (nrow(stats_df) > 0) {
    has_sig <- any(stats_df$T_p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (has_sig) {
      significant_pathways <- c(significant_pathways, pathway_name)
    }
  }
}

if (length(significant_pathways) == 0) {
  for (pathway_name in names(all_results)) {
    stats_df <- all_results[[pathway_name]]$statistics
    if (nrow(stats_df) > 0 && any(stats_df$T_p_value < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      significant_pathways <- c(significant_pathways, pathway_name)
    }
  }
}

if (length(significant_pathways) == 0) {
  significant_pathways <- names(all_results)
}

# ===========================================
# Prepare Heatmap Data
# ===========================================

cluster_levels <- c("Black", "Gray1", "Gray2", "Gray3", "Gray4")

heatmap_data <- matrix(NA, 
                       nrow = length(significant_pathways), 
                       ncol = length(cluster_levels),
                       dimnames = list(significant_pathways, cluster_levels))

for (pathway in significant_pathways) {
  scores_df <- all_results[[pathway]]$scores
  
  cluster_means <- scores_df %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(mean_score = mean(Pathway_Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')
  
  for (cluster in cluster_levels) {
    if (cluster %in% cluster_means$condition) {
      heatmap_data[pathway, cluster] <- cluster_means$mean_score[cluster_means$condition == cluster]
    }
  }
}

heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[rowSums(!is.na(heatmap_data)) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
heatmap_data_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data)))
heatmap_data_scaled[is.na(heatmap_data_scaled)] <- 0

# ===========================================
# Prepare Row Annotations
# ===========================================

annotation_row <- data.frame(
  row.names = rownames(heatmap_data_scaled)
)

min_p_values <- sapply(rownames(heatmap_data_scaled), function(pathway) {
  stats_df <- all_results[[pathway]]$statistics
  if (nrow(stats_df) > 0) {
    return(min(stats_df$T_p_value, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  return(NA)
})

annotation_row$NegLog10_P <- -log10(min_p_values + 1e-10)
annotation_row$Significance <- cut(min_p_values,
                                   breaks = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1),
                                   labels = c("p<0.001", "p<0.01", "p<0.05", "p<0.1", "NS"),
                                   include.lowest = TRUE)

annotation_row$Significance <- factor(annotation_row$Significance, 
                                      levels = c("p<0.001", "p<0.01", "p<0.05", "p<0.1", "NS"))

# ===========================================
# Prepare Column Annotations
# ===========================================

annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Cluster = factor(colnames(heatmap_data_scaled), levels = cluster_levels),
  row.names = colnames(heatmap_data_scaled)
)

significance_colors <- c(
  "p<0.001" = "#d73027",
  "p<0.01" = "#fc8d59", 
  "p<0.05" = "#fee08b",
  "p<0.1" = "#d9ef8b",
  "NS" = "#ffffff"
)

annotation_colors <- list(
  Cluster = cluster_colors,
  Significance = significance_colors
)

# ===========================================
# Generate Heatmap
# ===========================================

heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)

if (exists("pathway_names_map")) {
  row_labels <- sapply(rownames(heatmap_data_scaled), function(x) {
    if(x %in% names(pathway_names_map)) pathway_names_map[[x]] else x
  })
} else {
  row_labels <- rownames(heatmap_data_scaled)
}

row_anno_for_plot <- data.frame(
  Significance = annotation_row$Significance,
  row.names = rownames(annotation_row)
)

pheatmap_result <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_data_scaled,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,    
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   
  show_rownames = TRUE,   
  show_colnames = TRUE,   
  labels_row = row_labels,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  border_color = NA,
  cellwidth = 45,
  cellheight = ifelse(nrow(heatmap_data_scaled) > 30, 10, 12),
  fontsize_row = ifelse(nrow(heatmap_data_scaled) > 30, 8, 9),
  fontsize_col = 11,
  angle_col = 45,
  treeheight_row = 0,
  treeheight_col = 0,
  color = heatmap_colors,
  breaks = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 101),
  main = "Significant Pathways by Cluster",
  gaps_col = 1:(ncol(heatmap_data_scaled)-1),
  silent = FALSE
)

# Save heatmap
output_dir <- "results/figures"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

png(file.path(output_dir, "ssGSEA_significant_pathways.png"), 
    width = 3000, height = 2500, res = 300)
print(pheatmap_result)
dev.off()

# ===========================================
# Save Results to Variable
# ===========================================

ssgsea_results <- list(
  all_results = all_results,
  statistics = all_statistics,
  significant_pathways = significant_pathways,
  heatmap_data = heatmap_data_scaled,
  pheatmap_object = pheatmap_result
)

# Save statistics to CSV
write.csv(all_statistics, 
          file.path("results/tables", "ssGSEA_statistics.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```
